capabilities.capability: Fixed edge HUD, marker and offline live pipeline
capabilities.state: Offline validation passed; G2 closed; G3 open
capabilities.evidence: The owner accepted rehearsed recovery; the green-input cause is unknown ([E79](#e79-g2-green-input-log-analysis-and-recovery-rehearsal-on-frame)). G3 stopped before any marker ([E83](#e83-g3-marker-observer-attempt-stopped-at-the-observer-scene-precondition)); the file-only analysis of the chair still on Frame predicts that the O3 precondition passes ([E88](#e88-a2-file-only-still-analysis-on-frame-the-chair-still-passes-the-o3-precondition)). On November 7 the marker tile appeared in the mirror for the first time and its whole pattern matched, but the corner tags did not decode at the tile's size in the mirror, so the attempt was rejected; one budgeted attempt remains ([E89](#e89-a4-marker-observer-attempt-on-frame-the-marker-appeared-and-its-tags-did-not-decode-at-the-mirrors-scale)). Production gates stay closed; [implementation and limits](evidence/capability-notes.md#fixed-edge-hud-marker-and-offline-live-pipeline).

capabilities.state: Phase 0 installed and re-verified on SteamOS 0.5.8; guard version 4 active; runner and guard enforcement untested on Frame

Installation does not validate automated checks or blocking. The review's cycle-3 follow-ups (glob guard, update signal handling and outcome, lock-file and checkout-state reporting, installer cleanup) are fixed, cloud-checked and merged ([E84](#e84-ship-pass-of-2026-11-06-cloud-checks-for-prs-22-24-25-26-and-27)); none has run as a task on Frame. The installer re-run at 6e648c7 on SteamOS 0.5.8 passed all five stages with the first recorded signature pass of Claude Code 2.1.319, and the pull to 45771fe made guard version 4 the active guard with the settings file unchanged ([E86](#e86-installer-run-at-6e648c7-on-frame-first-signature-pass-of-claude-code-21319-and-the-guard-version-4-disclosure)). [Coverage and follow-ups](evidence/capability-notes.md#guarded-on-device-agent-runner).
